notes.title: Release Date SET: Feb 15th!!
notes.notes:
Valve have now approved ZANGEKI WARP for release and it will be available at the Steam Store this Wednesday (Feb 15th)!

As a make-good / couple of bonus items for the delay, there will be a 10% launch discount and we will be concurrently adding trading cards to our previous ASTRO PORT release ARMED SEVEN for the fans.

Apologies to all for the delay, and thank you for your patience! 

Get HYPErdimensional!!
